projects.name: FlowForge
projects.pitch: Runs multi-step AI workflows that survive failures. A supervisor routes work to specialist agents that call tools over MCP, every step is checkpointed in PostgreSQL so a run can resume, and risky actions pause for human approval.

projects.name: QueryPilot
projects.pitch: Ask your database questions in plain English. It writes the SQL, validates it with SQLGlot, waits for human review, runs it on the supported databases and explains the result. LangGraph retries and corrects queries that fail.

projects.name: I.Vision
projects.pitch: Your own knowledge, searchable by chat. Feed it PDFs, docs, slides, websites and YouTube transcripts; it retrieves the best-matching chunks, streams the answer with cited sources, and says so when it doesn’t know instead of guessing.

projects.name: HealthnexAI
projects.pitch: Health risk assessment from lifestyle and family history. ML models estimate risk for diabetes, heart disease, blood pressure, obesity and mental health, and an LLM assistant explains the result and builds a personal prevention plan.
